headline: Predictors for metal sites, molecular contacts and AlphaFold3 performance gaps
label: Structural Prediction And Evaluation Tools
summary: Recent tools and evaluations address metal-site prediction, contact scoring, NMR-informed property prediction and AlphaFold3 generalization limits.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational representation of molecular structure for prediction and evaluation, though the four items span distinct applications rather than a single method. BioMetAll v2.0 extends metal-binding site prediction with metal-specific scoring and side-chain, first-coordination-sphere descriptors. A rank-based atom environment representation and fitness score (FS) discriminate native X-ray structures in molecular contact assessment. On the evaluation side, AlphaFold3 shows uneven performance and training-data dependence across ubiquitinated proteins, TCR-epitope, antibody-antigen, protein-RNA and protein-lipid tasks. NMR-AI takes a different route, combining predicted 1H/13C shifts with ECFP4 fingerprints to improve logP, logS, logD and pKa prediction, with up to 39% lower RMSE. The novelty lies in encoding local chemical environments, metal identity, and predicted spectroscopic information as model features.
